title: Transporting Treatment Effects from One-Way Subgroup Summaries of Randomized Trials
banked_reason: Sound mathematics, but the independent global-certificate audit and the structural one-release frontier beyond positive rank three remain open; calibrated ceiling 5.2 is below the field floor 7.4.
gap_reasons: Generic real-algebraic elimination does not provide the independent model-specific certificate or the structural release frontier.
No retained row-by-row artifact independently compares direct elimination of the original uncancelled compatibility equations with the complete chart union.
Reduced necessary-and-sufficient criteria are still missing for rank-two, lower-rank, boundary, mixed-support, disconnected, fallback, and cross-chart regimes.
proof_attempt_summary: Two D0 solve rounds, six scoped directives, and a bounded maximality pass established a finite at-most-two-variable quadratic support atlas, a fixed-chart component procedure, exact positive rank-three release criteria, and compatible causal countermodels. The math review passed, but the retained exhaustive original-equations-versus-chart audit was never produced and the structural one-release frontier remained open outside positive rank three. The calibrated D0.5 gate therefore rated the honest delivered package incremental rather than field-tier.
tldr: One-way randomized-trial subgroup summaries admit a proved finite atlas of guarded quadratic charts for the common four-cell-effect compatibility fiber, and the restored proved exact component routine decides target constancy within each chart. The global certificate remains open: neither the immutable core nor the supplied draft contains the independently retained, row-by-row direct-elimination audit required to compare every original support, rank, anchor, pivot, singular, tangent, endpoint, mixed-support, disconnected, and overlap branch with the complete chart union. The effective question is restricted to admissible certified real-algebraic trial releases and target laws, and \(\mathsf{EMPTY}\) means exactly \(F=\varnothing\).
gap: Existing aggregate-data transport theory identifies a parametric CATE under assumptions guaranteeing uniqueness. Moon gives a sharp interval for fixed linear combinations of pooled conditional outcome means from group means, group shares, and within-group univariate covariate marginals, with one-way conditional means available as extra restrictions. Generic real-closed-field quantifier elimination also decides emptiness and target constancy for exact algebraic inputs. What remains unresolved is a causal-model-specific, support-complete and auditable certificate over all Fréchet endpoints, anchor ranks, six effect pivots, singular or reducible components, tangencies, isolated points, constant-effect branches, disconnected charts, overlaps, and mixed supports, followed by distinct conditional-reportability and total-policy one-release frontiers.
fill: First prove an exhaustive geometric atlas for arbitrary real releases, then, for certified real-algebraic inputs, develop terminating EMPTY, IDENTIFIED, and NONIDENTIFIED certificates using square-free factorization, subresultants, Sturm or Thom isolation, and exact sign tables. Verify original fiber equations and support guards for every witness, compare all components globally, and retain the separate zero-versus-one-scalar conditional and total repair classifications. The generic positive two-trial rank-three rule remains a benchmark rather than a substitute for the support-complete audit.
